description: Fill a form on this tab with what Yab keeps for the user. what: form fills a whole form (sign-up, event registration, application, contact) from the user's address, their profile (company, title, location, LinkedIn, X, GitHub, site, bio) and what they answered the same questions before, all at once and faster than typing, and says which boxes are left: questions only words answer (write those with type, from the profile it sends back), and ones that are the user's alone (money, bank details, ids, consent), which you leave or ask about. Never ticks consent and never submits. card or address fill a checkout: a card waits for the user's Touch ID and its number is never shown to you; its security code fills with it when the user paid with one before; if the page still asks for one, call handoff for the user to type it. An address is filled once the user says yes. With several cards, pass card (its last four digits) when the task says which; without it the user picks one.

card.description: The last four digits of the card to use
